$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. BindingProfile per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §2.6: 'device- and user-specific resolution of abstract package slots to actual models, repositories, execution targets, devices, secrets, policies, and budgets. Binding profiles are not publishable package content (FB-RAT-WEB-005 — packages declare typed binding slots; Fonebrew resolves them locally).' A BindingProfile document MUST NEVER be embedded in, or shipped as part of, a .floop LoopPackage archive (floop-container-format.v1.json's requiredTopLevelLayout has no slot for one) — it lives only in this phone's own local store, referenced by LoopInstallation.bindingProfileRef (loop-installation.schema.json). `substitutionPolicy` per binding is the FB-RAT-CMP-003 four-value enum — copied verbatim from docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §5, not the task-brief's abbreviated three-value paraphrase.
title: BindingProfile
description: The local, device-and-user-specific resolution of one release's abstract binding slots (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §9) to actual local resources — models, repositories, execution targets, devices, secrets (by reference only), policies, and budgets. Produced by LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5's binding-resolution-order procedure and consumed at activation. NOT publishable package content (see $comment) — a package build pipeline (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §5) MUST NOT include a BindingProfile document in its output.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this profile's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

profileId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this profile (FB-RAT-COM-002).

loopId.description: The release family this profile binds against. LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5: 'a binding never survives a change of loopId... without fresh review' — carried here so a resolver can cheaply reject a stale profile before even comparing packageDigest.

semanticVersion.description: The release version this profile was resolved against, or the compatible version range it was approved to survive into (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 — 'or a user-approved compatible version range'). Null only when scoping is by packageDigest alone (no range approval given).

packageDigest.description: The exact packageContentDigest (floop-container-format.v1.json) this profile was resolved against. A profile is scoped to this digest unless `semanticVersion` above additionally records a user-approved range (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5).

slotBindings.description: One entry per resolved binding slot (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5's required binding-record field list). MUST have unique slotId values — see the $comment on the `uniqueSlotIds` marker below; JSON Schema draft 2020-12 has no native 'unique by key' keyword, so uniqueness of slotId specifically (as opposed to whole-item uniqueness, which `uniqueItems` would check) is a documented, not structurally enforced, invariant. See fixtures/loops/binding-profile/adversarial for the schema-valid-but-duplicate-slotId case.

producer.description: The app instance that produced this profile.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

slotId.description: The package's abstract placeholder slot ID being resolved (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §9, e.g. 'model.writer', 'repository.primary', 'ci.default', 'device.target', 'secret.release_signing').

requirement.description: Human-readable copy of the slot's declared requirement, for display without re-fetching the package manifest.

selectedProviderId.description: The actual local resource this slot resolved to (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'selected provider/resource ID').

providerVersion.description: Version of the selected provider/resource, when the resource kind carries one (e.g. a model build, a tool version).

targetType.description: The resource kind this slot resolved to (e.g. 'model', 'repository', 'executionTarget', 'device', 'secret') — LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'provider version and target type'.

substitutionPolicy.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §5's four-value policy (FB-RAT-CMP-003): EXACT_ONLY (fixed, no substitution possible), DECLARED_EQUIVALENTS (phone auto-resolves among a package-declared list), USER_APPROVED (user confirms any phone-proposed value), ANY_COMPATIBLE (phone auto-resolves any locally available value meeting the slot's declared capability requirements).

substitutionReason.description: Required in practice whenever substitutionPolicy is not EXACT_ONLY (FB-RAT-CMP-003) — see the `if`/`then` below for the one direction this schema DOES enforce structurally (EXACT_ONLY forbids a reason, since there is nothing to explain).

provenance.description: LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'local/cloud/remote provenance' of the resolved resource.

constraints.description: Open bag for slot-specific constraints (e.g. a context-length floor, a latency ceiling) — LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'constraints'.

budgets.description: Open bag for slot-specific budget dimensions (e.g. a per-call cost ceiling) — LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'budgets'.

secretReferenceId.description: A Keystore-held secret HANDLE ID only (security/KeystoreSecret.kt) — LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §9's fb.secret.use purpose-bound-handle mechanism. This field MUST NEVER carry a raw secret value; see fixtures/loops/binding-profile/adversarial for the fixture modeling exactly that violation (schema-valid string, semantically forbidden content).

allOf.$comment: EXACT_ONLY is the fixed, no-substitution case (LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §5) — there is no substitution to explain, so a non-null reason here would be self-contradictory.
